jobs.title: Senior Clinical Laboratory Associate
jobs.description:
About Karius

Karius is a life science, venture-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

Position Summary

The Sr. Clinical Laboratory Associate (Sr. CLA) is an enthusiastic, self-motivated individual with great communication skills. Along with the duties described below, this individual leads and organizes efforts around sample receiving and accessioning, performance of routine preventive equipment and instrument maintenance, and provides assistance in the performance of high complexity laboratory testing on patient specimens under the direct supervision of a CLS. The Sr. CLA must demonstrate an exceptional level of individual accountability and possess the ability to perform the requirements listed below. The Sr. CLA must be comfortable in a rapidly evolving Biotech start-up environment.

Shift:
Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 3:30 pm

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life-changing impact on people, and at scale.

Reports to:
Sr. Manager, Clinical Laboratory Operations

Location:
Redwood City, CA

Primary Responsibilities

Under supervision of licensed personnel, perform high complexity testing for commercial samples in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and laboratory SOPs.
For non-commercial or clinical study samples, perform routine molecular test procedures including specimen processing, nucleic acid extraction, quantitative analysis, PCR, library construction, sequencing, and data analysis.
Support operational lab staff with sample receiving and accessioning per relevant standard operating procedures (SOPs); serve as primary point of contact with the customer support team to obtain information necessary to complete the accessioning process.
Prepare samples for processing in accordance with good laboratory practices and established contamination control procedures.
Operate high-throughput integrated automation workstations and utilize laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and other infrastructure software in the performance of job duties
Coordinates directly with the procurement department to ensure reagents and materials are available, qualified, and supplied to the laboratory for optimal performance of daily workflow.
Assists in ordering and identification of alternative suppliers as necessary.
Perform and document routine preventive maintenance for laboratory equipment and instruments.
Support regulatory compliance through adherence to laboratory policies and procedures, and accurately document work performed.
Author and revise laboratory SOPs with minimal direction, ensuring applicable regulatory requirements are reflected in controlled documents.
Identify, escalate, and lead process improvement initiatives; monitor and report on post-implementation performance.
Supports the coordination of daily CLA activities under the direction of the Supervisor.
Serve as point trainer for assigned processes and procedures; coordinate with management to support competency assessments as appropriate.
Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisory or laboratory leadership personnel.

What’s Fun About the Job?

Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. To deliver on that value, you will be tapping into some of the most advanced technologies, architecting and innovating where the current solutions simply don't suffice. You will get to see how much your work really matters.

Travel
: No travel required.

Physical Requirements

Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs
Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary.
May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high speed centrifugation
Manual dexterity as repetitive manual pipetting may be necessary
Some lifting (up to 25 pounds) may be necessary

Position Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Biological science or similar field required.
5+ (five) years of clinical laboratory experience, with 4+ (four) years of pertinent industry experience and increasing levels of responsibility within a molecular biology laboratory
Demonstrated ability to manage projects independently, or with minimal supervision.
Prior experience with Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) preferred.
Knowledge of aseptic techniques used in a microbiology laboratory is highly preferred.

Personal Qualifications

Demonstrates personal accountability and ownership of assigned work and processes, consistently delivering results with quality, consistency, and attention to detail
Proactively identifies, communicates, and escalates issues, risks, or deviations in a timely and transparent manner
Adapts effectively to changing priorities and operational demands in a dynamic laboratory environment
Demonstrates awareness of how individual responsibilities impact upstream and downstream laboratory operations
Serves as a knowledgeable resource to peers, providing guidance and support to junior laboratory personnel
Demonstrates curiosity and learning agility, seeking to understand laboratory processes beyond immediate scope and remaining open to feedback, coaching, and continuous skill development
Maintains a collaborative, respectful, and team-oriented approach to daily operations

We seek to understand how cells, tissues, and organisms respond and adapt to chronic hypoxia at the molecular and whole-body physiology levels. The Opportunity (Full-time, San Francisco)

Taxa engineers the microbiome. We design live bacterial therapeutics and deliver them to people. This role owns the day-to-day operation of that pipeline and keeps it running at throughput.

We are seeking a reliable, experienced pipeline operator to run and improve our core NGS workflows end to end. This is fundamentally a next-generation sequencing role: library prep, whole-genome and metagenomics sequencing across short- and long-read platforms, executed as dependable production operations rather than one-off experiments. Much of the pipeline is automated, so deep, hands-on fluency with a diverse array of laboratory automation equipment is central to the job.

You will operate and maintain liquid-handling and sample-handling systems, navigate the practical realities of automation (plate and tube formats, racking, sample tracking, instrument integration), and harden unit operations. 

Nothing in your pipeline is a black box: you've interrogated every reagent, kit, instrument, and QC step a sample touches. You run workflows that are reproducible, traceable, and dependent on processes rather than people. You'll operate as an independent scientist within a lean, highly skilled team, with full ownership over your workflows, your research agenda, and their results.

Required Qualifications

✔️ NGS pipeline operations — Hands-on, high-throughput expertise across the sequencing workflow: NGS library prep, isolate whole-genome sequencing, and shotgun metagenomics on short- and long-read platforms (Illumina, ONT, Element). You run sequencing as production, with the QC discipline to keep data quality high at volume.

✔️ Laboratory automation expertise — Deep experience using and managing a diverse array of laboratory automation equipment. You work closely with the team to develop and run high-throughput protocols on liquid-handling and sample-handling robots (e.g., Opentrons, Tecan, Avidien/Apricot, QPix). About Pendulum

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. Job Description

The Staff Research Associate (SRA) assists the principal investigator (PI) with active experiments and the daily tasks related to the operation of a biomedical research laboratory. This is a great opportunity for individuals interested in graduate school in the biomedical sciences.

Our research is primarily focused on: 1) chronic hypoxia sensing and adaptation, 2) mechanisms of pericarditis, and 3) lipid metabolism in hypoxia. We seek to understand how cells, tissues, and organisms respond and adapt to chronic hypoxia at the molecular and whole-body physiology levels. We utilize a variety of in vitro (cell) models and mouse models to investigate specific transcription factors, gene and protein regulatory pathways, and metabolic changes in mediating responses under hypoxia. This work lies at the intersection of hypoxia signaling, lipid metabolism, and cardiovascular disease. We have developed models of cardiovascular disease that are affected by chronic hypoxia, including pulmonary hypertension, heart failure, and obesity. We use various biochemical assays, “multi-omics,” and computational approaches to carefully dissect mechanisms of hypoxia adaptation and lipid rewiring in hypoxia. In addition, we are interested in dissecting mechanisms of recurrent pericarditis, using mouse models of pericarditis and patient samples.

Research Associate, NGS Pipeline Operations
The Opportunity (Full-time, San Francisco)

Taxa engineers the microbiome. We design live bacterial therapeutics and deliver them to people. Sequencing is the backbone of that work: every strain we ship, and sample we get back, passes through our NGS pipeline. This role owns the day-to-day operation of that pipeline and keeps it running at throughput.

We are seeking a reliable, experienced pipeline operator to run and improve our core NGS workflows end to end. This is fundamentally a next-generation sequencing role: library prep, whole-genome and metagenomics sequencing across short- and long-read platforms, executed as dependable production operations rather than one-off experiments. Much of the pipeline is automated, so deep, hands-on fluency with a diverse array of laboratory automation equipment is central to the job.

You will operate and maintain liquid-handling and sample-handling systems, navigate the practical realities of automation (plate and tube formats, racking, sample tracking, instrument integration), and harden unit operations. 

Nothing in your pipeline is a black box: you've interrogated every reagent, kit, instrument, and QC step a sample touches. You run workflows that are reproducible, traceable, and dependent on processes rather than people. You'll operate as an independent scientist within a lean, highly skilled team, with full ownership over your workflows, your research agenda, and their results.

Required Qualifications

✔️ NGS pipeline operations — Hands-on, high-throughput expertise across the sequencing workflow: NGS library prep, isolate whole-genome sequencing, and shotgun metagenomics on short- and long-read platforms (Illumina, ONT, Element). You run sequencing as production, with the QC discipline to keep data quality high at volume.

✔️ Laboratory automation expertise — Deep experience using and managing a diverse array of laboratory automation equipment. You work closely with the team to develop and run high-throughput protocols on liquid-handling and sample-handling robots (e.g., Opentrons, Tecan, Avidien/Apricot, QPix). You also handle hardware integration, deck and labware configuration, and sample-tracking systems as part of your core skill set.

✔️ Bacterial isolation and culture — Isolating, culturing, and maintaining diverse bacteria at scale, including selective/differential media, colony picking and arraying into plate formats, and cryobanking, including non-model organisms with slow or fastidious growth.

✔️ Laboratory and data organization — Maintains a spotless, efficient lab; tracks every sample, plate, reagent, and instrument with precision; uses ELNs and structured metadata so workflows are fully documented, traceable, and reproducible.

✔️ Full on-site availability — based in or willing to relocate to the Bay Area.

✔️ Flexible working hours — Availability for irregular managing the pipeline at irregular hours: morning, evening, or weekends.

✔️ Authorized to work in the U.S. — Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Highly Desirable Experience

✔️ Microbial-interaction and phenotypic/genotypic assays — Designing and running in vitro screens across isolates (e.g., growth/inhibition and antagonism assays, colony PCR, marker genotyping, arrayed functional and co-culture assays) and building triage logic that prioritizes which strains advance.

✔️ Miniaturization, cost-down, and method development from literature — Scaling workflows down in volume and cost while holding data quality, and rapidly evaluating, implementing, and adapting protocols from publications to specific platforms.

✔️ Troubleshooting complex failures — Diagnosing multi-factor issues spanning assay chemistry, instrumentation, and sequencing.

✔️ Low-biomass and challenging samples — Recovering and processing organisms from low-biomass, mixed, or otherwise difficult primary samples.

Transparent Compensation

✔️ Benefits — comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

✔️ Retirement — 401(k) plan with 6% employer match.

About Pendulum

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.
